title: The HyperFrog Cryptosystem: High-Genus Voxel Topology as a Trapdoor for Post-Quantum KEMs
summary: HyperFrog is an experimental post-quantum Key Encapsulation Mechanism that explores a variant of the Learning With Errors (LWE) design space in which the secret is not sampled from an independent product distribution, but is deterministically derived from discrete topological structure. The scheme embeds a voxel grid in three dimensions and uses a topology mining procedure to search for connected subgraphs with prescribed complexity, measured by cyclomatic number (high genus).
